title: Mind the Gaps: State-Guided Supervision Allocation for Object Detection Dataset Distillation
abstract: arXiv:2611.30369v1 Announce Type: cross  Abstract: Recent advances in dataset distillation have enabled large-scale training datasets to be compressed into compact synthetic sets. However, dataset distillation for object detection remains challenging, as it requires preserving diverse classification and localization signals under limited image budgets. Existing approaches often emphasize individual-image informativeness without explicitly accounting for supervision accumulated across the distilled dataset, potentially leading to redundant supervision and uneven class-scale coverage. To address this limitation, we propose State-Guided Supervision Allocation (SGSA), a framework that formulates object detection dataset distillation as a dataset-level progressive supervision allocation problem. translated_title: 注意差距：面向目标检测数据集蒸馏的状态引导监督分配
translated_abstract: 数据集蒸馏领域的最新进展使得大规模训练数据集能够被压缩为紧凑的合成数据集。然而，目标检测的数据集蒸馏仍然具有挑战性，因为它需要在有限的图像预算下保留多样化的分类与定位信号。现有方法往往只强调单张图像的信息量，而没有显式考虑在整个蒸馏数据集上累积的监督信息，这可能导致监督冗余和类别-尺度覆盖不均衡。为解决这一局限，我们提出了状态引导监督分配（SGSA），该框架将目标检测数据集蒸馏形式化为数据集层面的渐进式监督分配问题。SGSA建立类别-尺度监督配额，并维护一个全局状态以跟踪从先前选定的合成图像中累积的检测器预测……（摘要原文在此处截断）
tldr: 该论文提出SGSA框架，将目标检测数据集蒸馏建模为数据集层面的渐进式监督分配问题，通过类别-尺度监督配额与全局状态跟踪消除冗余监督并均衡类别-尺度覆盖。
en_tdlr: This paper proposes SGSA, which formulates object detection dataset distillation as a dataset-level progressive supervision allocation problem, using class-scale supervision quotas and a global state to reduce redundant supervision and balance class-scale coverage.
